title: Correct products can become growing competitors for the next donor
statement: At fixed stage j, donor F reaches correct/wrong/lost at rates k,w,lambda or diverts to retained-product sulfur at j*b; S returns at r, goes permanently wrong at x or loses donor at h. Let g=r+x+h>0,k>0. With equivalent competent loss restart, P_j=k/[k+w+j*b*x/g]. If the same declared conditional laws apply along all-correct history, P_L=product_j P_j. For w=x=h=0,r>0, harmless F-restarting loss allowed, expected diversions before L intended completions are(b/k)*L*(L-1)/2.

requires: Finite nonnegative constant rates, k>0,g=r+x+h>0; integer j>=0 retained chemically accessible product handles and positive integer L.
Every claimed harmless loss restores equivalent donor supply and the same competent continuing chemical state; all-correct stages obey the supplied conditional laws.
The quadratic harmless-detour count additionally requires w=x=h=0,r>0; it is not the general wrong-product probability.

assumptions: Actual sulfur accessibility and wrong-transfer x are unacquired; x=0/inaccessibility is a distinct surviving case.
Restoring donor availability without chemical competence/rates is not the renewal premise.
costs: All replacement/clearance/time and diverted residence costs remain; retained products cannot be removed as waste.
contract.units: Rates inverse time, b per completed product; hazard ratios/probabilities dimensionless, detours integer events.
contract.obstruction: Measure actual retained-product reactivity and competent return before applying a constant-hazard or whole-product self-silencing model.

body: Eliminate S in the first-step equations. Trial correct, wrong and loss probabilities are proportional to k, w+j*b*x/g and lambda+j*b*h/g, normalized by their sum. Renewing only the genuinely harmless loss branches gives trial_correct/(trial_correct+trial_wrong), so lambda cancels from eventual odds, not waiting time, donor use or cleanup. Replacement must restore the continuing root/product state and equivalent rates, not only an empty carrier. Set rho0=w/k and s=b*x/(k*g): P_j=1/(1+rho0+s*j). The stage product is a chain of conditional probabilities, not a certificate for arbitrary aging/correlated histories. The small-hazard logarithm has leading-L*rho0-s*L*(L-1)/2; use the exact product outside that regime. Retained correct material cannot be washed away as spent donors. x denotes hypothesized net wrong transfer to another reactive site, not second same-nitrogen amidation; inaccessible/silenced sulfur or x=0 removes its permanent-error slope. Separately, when w=x=h=0, each free-donor occupation has competing intended and diversion intensities k,j*b, giving j*b/k expected detours before intended completion, summed over j. r>0 returns every detour and harmless donor-loss replacement is paid. Detours are resource events, not permanent wrong products. Source route comparison is exact when log(1+rho_cap)<mean_j log(1+rho0+s*j); the482 crossover and yields remain hypothetical source calculations.
